tooltip.simplesandwiches.knife.recipe: Craft with a stick at bottom left and four iron nuggets at top right, center, middle right and bottom center.
simplesandwiches.guide.page.1.title: Simple Sandwiches
simplesandwiches.guide.page.1: Sandwiches on a cutting board, a kitchen knife, cheese and butter from the cauldron, and eating straight out of bundles.
simplesandwiches.guide.page.2.title: Sandwiches
simplesandwiches.guide.page.2: One bread plus up to five ingredients, with optional butter first; matching components stack to 16.
simplesandwiches.guide.page.3.title: Cutting board
simplesandwiches.guide.page.3: Place bread, open with the knife, add toppings, then close and collect with an empty hand.
simplesandwiches.guide.page.4.title: Knife
simplesandwiches.guide.page.4: 250 durability, total attack damage 2, attack speed 2.0 and anvil repair with iron nuggets.
simplesandwiches.guide.page.5.title: Cheese and butter
simplesandwiches.guide.page.5: Milk ripens into butter automatically; a fermented spider eye starts cheese ripening with a limited harvest window.
simplesandwiches.guide.page.6.title: Eating from bundles
simplesandwiches.guide.page.6: Hold use to eat the selected food in a bundle, or its first item when none is selected.
quests.simplesandwiches.start.title: Welcome to Simple Sandwiches
quests.simplesandwiches.start.subtitle: Your free guide
quests.simplesandwiches.start.welcome.de: Craft or pick up a crafting table and claim the Simple Sandwiches Guide as a reward. You can also craft it from a book and bread.
